basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 19-year-old college student from Maple Ridge, Canada, currently exploring my identity and interests. I joined Reddit to connect with people who share my experiences and to learn more about topics like bisexuality, mental health, and digital marketing. I'm still figuring out my major, but I'm interested in psychology and social media marketing. Most of my online activity happens in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy reading, photography, and spending time with friends in my spare time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having just started college, I am in the early stages of developing my academic and personal interests. I have a basic understanding of social media marketing from a part-time internship and am exploring topics related to sexuality and identity through communities on Reddit. My knowledge is primarily self-taught and based on personal experiences.
